digest.component_or_area: LLM runner / CI weekly jobs (external-integration, prompt-eval)
propositions: Weekly LLM jobs (external-integration and prompt-eval) make real billable calls but capture no persistent, retrievable record of token usage (input, output, cache tokens and request count).

Per-call usage is computed and logged in PydanticAIRunner.run but never propagates to job output: runner INFO logs are suppressed by NullHandler, eval paths drop _usage on return, and external pytest tier surfaces nothing.
Implement a shared opt-in usage sink (usage_log.py) that records usage to JSONL when REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var is set, hooked at the PydanticAIRunner._usage seam already common to both jobs.

Both weekly workflows (prompt-eval eval-live job and external-integration external job) must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG, run summarize to append Markdown summary to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, and upload raw JSONL artifact.
